description: This file defines a master orchestrator for Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) responses, including various modes (quick, standard, thorough) and individual metric evaluations such as faithfulness, relevance, hallucination, and constitutional checks. It registers asynchronous functions to handle different evaluation workflows, calling external evaluation functions and aggregating their results into a comprehensive report.

classes.name: RAGEvaluationResult
classes.description: Data class representing the aggregated evaluation results, including scores and verdicts.

classes.name: FaithfulnessVerdict
classes.description: Verdict about the faithfulness aspect of the response.

classes.name: RelevanceVerdict
classes.description: Verdict about the relevance aspect of the response.

classes.name: ConstitutionalReport
classes.description: Report on adherence to constitutional principles.

methods.name: register_orchestrator_reasoners(router)
methods.description: Registers all the evaluation functions with the provided router object, defining the orchestrations and individual metric evaluations.

methods.name: dict aggregate_results( faithfulness: Dict, relevance: Dict, hallucination: Dict, constitutional: Dict, mode: str, ai_calls: int )
methods.description: Combines individual metric evaluation results into a comprehensive final report with overall scores, verdicts, and recommendations.
